# CivicAscent AI project-wide coding instructions

Before proposing, editing, reviewing, merging or deploying ANY CivicAscent site page, read:
- [Repository shared agent guidance](../AGENTS.md)
- [Approved sitewide FF skill](../skills/civicascent-sitewide-ff/SKILL.md)
- [Approved design/project memory baseline](../docs/project-memory/sitewide-approved-design-ff-2026-10-15.md)

Use the approved screenshot-matched three-choice homepage for accessible information architecture, and keep original four-room cinematic Safari world separate and visually intact. Apply WCAG 2.2 AA principles and preserve independently colored room scenes and working routes. Use FF=Find→Fix→Retest, pre-/post-savepoints, screenshot-based Chromium verification, and no unsupported production claims. The budget is $0 and paid checkout must remain disabled. Do not change a page's approved visuals or claim a live deployment without matching verified evidence.
